    MIMORA connects people through practical knowledge. Recreate an expert’s craft, understand each difference, and refine your practice with every attempt.

    01

    Keep the original

    Choose a learning profile, then add the expert’s recording and your attempt. Your skill and media shape the workspace: phrase practice, craft steps, presentation review, movement or music.

    02

    Compare with care

    Replay original moments and record what you observe. Music supports note-event alignment and timing measurements. Other skills use guided review, without automatically judging pronunciation, movement or craftsmanship.

    03

    Listen. Practice. Retry.

    Replay each corresponding moment. Listen to coaching, save the text report, and record again. Sign in to keep your profile and saved reports across devices. Instructor decisions remain in the exported report.

    The MIMORA ethos

    Every skill carries a human connection: a mentor, a family member, an artisan, or someone who took the time to teach. MIMORA keeps that connection alive by making their knowledge easier to learn from and pass on.

    Recreating an expert’s craft is a starting point. Reflection, meaningful feedback, and continuous practice help you develop your own understanding and work toward expertise in the field you choose.

    What works in this release

    • Profile-based workspaces for language, craft, movement, presentation and music; email sign-in and shared reports when cloud setup is connected.
    • Real MIDI parsing, note sequence matching, missing/extra notes, and timing measurements.
    • Local audio pitch estimation, with uncertain findings and no automatic score.
    • Audio/video upload, camera recording, aligned playback, rubric settings, and instructor review.
    • Craft and language practice: compare recordings and add timestamped observations manually. No automated pressure, object orientation, or pronunciation assessment.
    • Optional MediaPipe hand landmarks for inspecting a paused video frame. Landmarks are never treated as proof of technique errors.
    • Browser spoken feedback and text downloads. Run the local server for downloadable spoken WAV files.

    Recordings stay on this device. Optional hand inspection downloads a model; inference runs in your browser. Saving a report sends its text, measurements and compact waveforms to your account when connected. Local WAV export sends report text to the local speech endpoint. Browser voices may use the operating system’s speech service.

    Use recordings you have permission to practice with. Clear saved sessions at any time. When connected, sign-in syncs your profile and saved reports through your private account. Original audio and video remain on this device and are not used for model training.

    Practice settings

    The reference defines the exercise. Choose which differences matter.

    Note accuracy and rhythm have relative weights 35:30. Unavailable tone and technique dimensions are excluded. Alternate fingering is never penalized automatically.

    Use your learning goal and review categories to decide which details matter. Non-music workspaces use guided observations, not automatic proficiency scores.
